title: load_only child column on polymorphic relationship

labels.name: loader options
labels.description: ORM options like joinedload(), load_only(), these are complicated and have a lot of issues

body:
This is using sqlalchemy==1.2.14.
Following code snippet fails with en error. Did I misuse query options again?

```
from sqlalchemy import Column, ForeignKey, Integer, String, create_engine
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.orm import Query, aliased, contains_eager, relationship
from sqlalchemy.pool import NullPool

engine = create_engine('postgresql://***', poolclass=NullPool)
connection = engine.connect()
connection.begin()

Base = declarative_base()


class Parent(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'parent'
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    type = Column(String, nullable=False)
    __mapper_args__ = {'polymorphic_on': type}
    other_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('main.id'), nullable=False)


class Child1(Parent):
    __mapper_args__ = {'polymorphic_identity': 'child1'}
    ext = Column(String)


class Main(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'main'
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    parents = relationship(Parent)
    child1 = relationship(Child1)


Base.metadata.create_all(connection)

child1 = aliased(Child1)
q = Query(Main).outerjoin(child1, Main.child1).options(
    contains_eager(Main.child1.of_type(child1), alias=child1).load_only('ext')
)

print(q)
```
